prompts.name: watch-date-green
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE AI-generated premium e-commerce product photograph, portrait 4:5. Input 1 is only the campaign styling reference: refined warm cream watch cushion, soft warm window light, natural suede grain, warm ivory background, restrained luxury accessory photography. Input 2 is the actual physical merchandise and is the authority for product shape and colour. Subject: LEFT watch in the real group photo: emerald green sunburst dial, rose-gold case and bracelet, rose-gold baton hour markers and hands, circular date window at 3. No Arabic numerals, no subdials. Precisely retain the softly rounded square/cushion case outline, bezel proportions, crown at right, three-row articulated metal bracelet and visible dial design from that specific watch. Retain the small CASIO and QUARTZ dial lettering seen on the real watch; no other text or graphics. Present only that ONE watch around a cream cushion, with entire case and generous portions of both bracelet ends visible, straight-on slight three-quarter view. Centre the dial around 50% horizontal and 47% vertical with comfortable margins suitable for a square mobile crop. Remove all packaging stickers, hands and shop background. Do not invent a different model, stones, leather strap, additional displays or a rectangular Tank case. This is AI-styled imagery based on the supplied inventory, not a new watch design.

prompts.name: watch-contour-black
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE polished AI-styled premium product photograph, portrait 4:5. Both references show the SAME physical black Contour model. Preserve this exact softly rounded cushion case (slightly taller than wide, NOT circular), glossy gunmetal-black finish and articulated black bracelet, black dial with slender rose-gold hands and baton markers, Arabic 12 at top and 6 at bottom. Crucially this watch has NO DATE WINDOW and NO SUBDIALS. Do not add either. Preserve the visible lug, crown and bracelet pattern from the first actual-product reference; second reference clarifies the face. Place this exact watch around a warm ivory suede watch cushion, on a softly lit warm beige stone surface, quiet warm cream background, soft natural window light, refined shadows, realistic black metal reflections. Whole case entirely visible and comfortable margins above and below bracelet for square mobile crops. Dial centred x50% y46%. No hands, no vegetation, no props that distract, no overlay text or watermark. Keep any subtle actual dial lettering only if faithfully legible; never invent extra branding. Output only one photograph, not a collage.

prompts.name: watch-category-stock
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE landscape 3:2 AI-generated watch category campaign photograph. Input 1 is the approved composition/materials reference ONLY: cream silk and suede, watch on left 50%, softly lit uninterrupted cream silk on right 45% for dark HTML typography. Replace its fictional rectangular Tank watch with the ACTUAL Contour watch from input 2. Input 3 clarifies the same white-dial cushion shape at higher detail; actual product input 2 wins on bracelet/lug details. Preserve the true rounded cushion case, rose-gold finish, white/ivory dial with Arabic 12 and 6 and thin baton other markers, three slim hands, small right crown, matching rose-gold articulated bracelet and its actual link pattern. NO date window, NO subdials, NO round dial and NO squared rectangular Tank case. Let the watch rest naturally diagonally over the left silk folds, face centred approximately x28% y43%, entire case visible, bracelet extending top-left and lower-left. Right half remains calm low-detail warm cream. Match the refined warm campaign lighting of input 1 and preserve premium sharp material detail. Keep exact small FELIX dial lettering as on supplied watch, no overlay text or new logo/watermark. No website or mockup. This replaces the watch photograph within an existing curved banner; do not draw the banner shape.

prompts.name: watch-editorial-stock
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the FIRST image only. Preserve the adult fictional woman's pose, face, skin, hand anatomy, ivory tailoring, warm architectural background, lighting, camera framing and large dark quiet negative space on the left exactly. Change ONLY the watch on her wrist. Replace the fictional round mesh-strap watch with the supplied ACTUAL Contour model shown in references 2 and 3: softly rounded cushion case, rose-gold bezel and articulated rose-gold metal link bracelet (not mesh), ivory/white face, Arabic 12 and 6 with thin baton other hour markers, slim rose-gold hands, small crown. Keep the wristwatch and cream cuff readable in a square mobile crop; do not hide the watch under sleeve. No new typography, no watermarks, no graphic overlays, no other jewellery. Output one landscape 3:2 photograph only.
